output.question: What acquisitions has IBM made?
output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, IBM's most recent confirmed acquisitions are Logiq Consulting (announced September 24, 2026), HRL Laboratories (completed August 26, 2026), and Confluent (completed March 17, 2026). IBM also confirmed acquisitions of Hakkoda (closed April 2, 2025), HashiCorp (completed February 27, 2025), and Apptio (completed August 10, 2023). IBM's newsroom M&A index additionally lists Prescinto, Kubecost, SiXworks, Pliant, StreamSets and webMethods, Equine Global, Manta Software, Agyla, Polar Security, StepZen, Dialexa, Databand.ai, Neudesic, Sentaca, Envizi, Turbonomic, myInvenio, 7Summits, Nordcloud, Expertus Technologies, TruQua, Instana, WDG Automation and Spanugo among its acquisition announcements; some index entries describe intended or asset acquisitions rather than a separately confirmed corporate closing.

key_facts.fact: IBM announced the acquisition of Logiq Consulting, a UK cybersecurity consultancy.
IBM completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories.
IBM completed its acquisition of Confluent for $31 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of approximately $11 billion.
IBM acquired Hakkoda; the acquisition closed April 2, 2025, and financial details were not disclosed.
IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp for $35 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of $6.4 billion.
IBM completed its acquisition of Apptio after receiving all required regulatory approvals.

IBM's official mergers-and-acquisitions index lists additional acquisition announcements including Prescinto, Kubecost, SiXworks, Pliant, StreamSets, webMethods, Equine Global, Manta Software, Agyla, Polar Security, StepZen, Dialexa, Databand.ai, Neudesic, Sentaca, Envizi, Turbonomic, myInvenio, 7Summits, Nordcloud, Expertus Technologies, TruQua, Instana, WDG Automation and Spanugo.

passages.quote: IBM (NYSE: IBM) UK today announced the acquisition of Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy
IBM Completes Acquisition of HRL Laboratories to Accelerate the Future of Quantum

Under the terms of the agreement, IBM has acquired all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Confluent for $31 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of approximately $11 billion.
The acquisition closed on April 2, 2025, and financial details of the transaction were not disclosed.
The closing of IBM's acquisition of HashiCorp includes all of the issued and outstanding common shares of HashiCorp for $35 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of $6.4 billion.
IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced it has completed its acquisition of Apptio Inc. after receiving all required regulatory approvals.

caveats: The IBM newsroom page is an announcements index: it mixes completed acquisitions, announced intentions to acquire, and acquisitions of assets or capabilities.
This is not verified as a complete all-time historical list of every IBM acquisition, especially acquisitions announced before the newsroom index's earliest entries.
Logiq's page says IBM announced the acquisition but does not state a closing date; it should not be treated as confirmed closed solely from that page.
